description: The k-cycle Hecke-trace route into Xi_{k>=3} is pruned: Markov forces tr_M(standard element) = z^{k-1}, so nothing beyond Xi_2 is reachable. Exact at n=3, convention D.
verdict: PRUNED, scope-(a). The Markov property forces tr_M of every standard element to a power of z, so the k-cycle route reaches no Xi beyond Xi_2: 4 z_D^2 = (h + [2]_q Xi_2)^2 exactly, the proved k=2 identity squared, with Xi_3's coefficient free. Single-crossing powers likewise span only {1, Xi_2}. Xi_{k>=3} is a WEIGHT FUNCTIONAL, not a trace value; the Hecke Murnaghan-Nakayama literature supplies general-n per-block characters, not a bridge to it. qou-ximf's anti-fit fence is unchanged and still binds.
